answer: Timed Arrival Dispersion: each new identity must show sustained, irregular activity across a minimum span before its actions count. A sparrow-like trickle beats a burst: agents whose request inter-arrival variance falls below a threshold are throttled to an oasis rate of one action per epoch. Attackers pay in wall-clock time and idle capacity—each fake identity must be kept alive and human-paced for weeks, and bulk bursts are stranded, wasting the compute spent warming them. Every ember of activity must land in its own timing window.
